commit_message: Implement ADR 0136 project preview CPU residency
pr_title: Implement ADR 0136 preview asset residency and asynchronous streaming
pr_body: Implements ADR 0136 on current main: project-scoped preview CPU residency shared by Scene View and Animation Preview, bounded priority/aging materialization workers, in-flight dedupe, generation-aware atomic publish, reuse of successful background import results, last-good/placeholder cold behavior, shared GPU mesh residency ownership, and ADR0135 aggressive GPU reclaim integration without discarding CPU materialization. Follow-up commits on this same Draft PR complete device-scoped texture residency, bounded GPU upload and asynchronous PreviewRenderer warm-up.
